summary: Micware Co., Ltd., a Japan-based software developer, files Form 6-K disclosing the full exercise and closing of the underwriter's over-allotment option from its recent IPO. On May 27, 2026, A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners purchased an additional 427,500 ADSs at the IPO price of $8.00 per ADS, generating $3.42 million in extra gross proceeds. This brings the total IPO to 3,277,500 ADSs and aggregate gross proceeds of approximately $26.22 million. The filing is a routine post-IPO update on the greenshoe mechanism, not a special situation. There is no acquisition, divestiture, or strategic change; it simply reports the completion of a standard over-allotment exercise.
